input.summary: Require TrueLink to give 90 days' notice of non-renewal (its only convenience exit), leaving Client's 30-day notice unchanged.
input.comment: [Playbook] Our position is that a host may only exit at the end of a term and on at least 90 days' notice, so we have extended TrueLink's non-renewal notice to ninety (90) days while leaving our own 30-day notice unchanged.

ops.oldText: either Client or TrueLink deliver to the other written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year
ops.newText: Client delivers written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days, or TrueLink delivers such notice no later than ninety (90) days, prior to the end of said year
